notes: Governmental receipts/disbursements, transfers and the cash roll-forward come from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balance - Governmental Funds - Cash Basis, Total column (p4; report p7, gained in the v7 re-trim, which replaced the earlier use of the budget schedule for these lines). Its Total column matches the Combined Budget and Actual schedule (p9) line for line; the budget schedule's lines (actual + budget) stay in detail, the only detail schedule for the governmental funds. Governmental Grants received 15,350 (printed under Other Financing Sources, below the 946,257 total) is recorded as a receipt with outside_printed_total; the printed total is unchanged. Governmental cash roll: 1,169,471 + (946,257 + 15,350 grant) - 814,900 - 98,811 = 1,217,367, which equals the Balance Sheet - Governmental Funds - Cash Basis total (p3: checking 758,970 + certificates of deposit 458,397). Business-type (Water/Sewer enterprise) uses the accrual proprietary statement p6 (net position): Grants 25,500 recorded as a receipt with outside_printed_total (printed total unchanged): 1,136,246 + (351,031 + 25,500) - 491,838 + 98,811 transfers = 1,119,750. Cash-basis proprietary budget schedule (p10) differs slightly (water/sewer 340,247 vs operating revenue 339,742). Zero lines omitted. Proprietary cash flow statement (pp7-8) is not recorded since basis is cash (proprietary field null; ending cash 136,705, operating -21,440, capital -46,365, noncapital 36,789). Balance sheet: p1 Statement of Financial Position 'Total - Memorandum Only' column; printed 'Total liabilities' 1,225,000 is the long-term subtotal, so total liabilities computed 1,388,072 (ties to p5 enterprise 1,388,072 and balances: 3,732,012 = 1,388,072 + 6,823 + 2,337,117). Customer deposits shown as a deferred inflow as printed. Statement of Activities (p2) and cash flow reconciliation (p8) add nothing new. Page mapping: trimmed p1=report p4, p2=p5, p3=p6, p4=p7, p5=p8, p6=p9, p7=p10, p8=p11, p9=p24, p10=p25.
